title: Diagnostic reasoning workshop
diagnosis: Demonstration scenario. No patient diagnosis is provided.
treatmentPlan: Teaching template only. A qualified supervisor must supply and review a case-specific plan.
steps: Review the fictional scenario with your supervisor.
Record the findings and questions in the teaching template.
Discuss the plan and assessment criteria before any practical work.
materials: Demo template. Materials and instruments are not specified.
doctorTip: Use this page to organize supervised learning, not to guide patient care.
diagnosisAr: سيناريو تجريبي. لا يتضمن تشخيصًا لمريض.
treatmentPlanAr: قالب تعليمي فقط. يضع المشرف المؤهل خطة مناسبة للحالة ويراجعها.
